characterList.description: Orange triangular-shaped head, green eyes, short spiky green hair, red shirt, blue overalls. Always optimistic and inventive.
characterList.name: Phineas

characterList.description: Tall and slender, rectangular head with one eye perpetually half-closed, green hair, purple shirt, gray pants. Mostly silent, but a skilled engineer and builder.
characterList.name: Ferb

characterList.description: Tall and slender, long orange hair, red tank top, white skirt. Obsessed with busting her brothers' inventions.
characterList.name: Candace

characterList.description: Black hair in a ponytail with a pink bow, pink dress, white shoes. Has a crush on Phineas and often asks, 'Whatcha doin'?'.
characterList.name: Isabella

characterList.description: Large and stocky, brown buzz cut, black shirt with skull design, brown shorts. Acts tough but is loyal to his friends.
characterList.name: Buford

characterList.description: Slender, large red hair, green eyes, orange turtleneck, brown pants. Often oblivious to her sons' inventions.
characterList.name: Linda (Mom)

characterList.description: Red and blue costume, white spider emblem on chest and back, mask covers entire head. Agile and witty superhero.
characterList.name: Spider-Man

characterList.description: Red and gold metallic suit, triangular arc reactor on chest, mask covers entire head. Genius inventor and billionaire.
characterList.name: Iron Man

characterList.description: Large and muscular, green skin, torn purple pants. Possesses superhuman strength and rage issues.
characterList.name: Hulk

characterList.description: Muscular, blonde hair, red cape, blue and silver armor, carries a large hammer (Mjolnir). Norse god of thunder.
characterList.name: Thor
